plan_source: Wikimedia Commons File:Sketch plan of Delhi fort.jpg (Sketch plan of Delhi Fort, Gordon Sanderson 1912, copied from Fergusson; Public domain per Commons)
frame: OSM local metres, origin 28.6546038N 77.2407056E (data/traces/red-fort-q45957.trace.json, +-800 m window), x east, y north
transform: o = a*(px - i*py) + b (complex), px,py on the 2000-px-wide rendering (original px / 2.3225); plan top is east, plan left is north
accuracy: visual overlay of plan wall and OSM wall agrees to 10-30 m; stated registration accuracy +-30 m; plan scale 0.4836 m/px working vs dimension 'from Shah Burj to Asad Burj 630 m' consistent with OSM east wall 650 m
